name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Persist encrypted SSH deployment profiles and publish local projects through confirmation-gated SSH deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Securely remember SSH targets and publish local projects.
interface.longDescription: Stores named deployment profiles in the current user's OS credential protection, then packages and uploads the current local project with OpenSSH and runs an explicit command only after a hashed dry run and user confirmation. Private key contents are never accepted or read.
defaultPrompt: Save a secure SSH deployment profile for this server.
Deploy this local site using my saved production profile.
List my saved SSH deployment profiles.
